ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate the majority of the fluke surface, estimated at approximately 65-70% of the visible area, contrasted against low-intensity black pixels localized at the center and perimeter edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white blobs occupy the distal and central regions of both lobes. These are bordered by a dense black low-intensity region at the median notch/peduncle junction and along the entire trailing edge boundary. Discrete, thin, dark linear streaks intersect the white fields on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central depression is a deep, narrow V-shaped notch with an internal pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge exhibits an irregular, high-frequency serration pattern with multiple small peaks and valleys. A significant notch-like indentation is visible on the upper-outer corner of the left lobe (viewer's left) and a smaller one on the right tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a sigmoidal curve, showing convexity near the median notch transitioning into a concave sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, roughly circular dark spots are clustered near the distal tips and sporadically along the trailing edge, primarily within the white fields.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, dark, non-parallel linear rake marks are visible: at least four vertical-to-oblique marks on the left lobe and five on the right lobe, cutting through the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel-line scarring (rake marks) suggests historical physical trauma distributed across the ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The black mottling at the center forms a 'brush-stroke' pattern where the pigment bleeds unevenly into the white areas, creating a jagged boundary.
